title: GSA OASIS+ Continuously Open Multi-Agency Contracts
strategic_reason: no program ceiling or cap on awards
continuous open solicitation and rolling admissions
six contract families including Total Small Business and Unrestricted
13 professional-service domains including R&D, Technical & Engineering, Intelligence Services, Logistics, Management & Advisory, and Enterprise Solutions

worldshepherd_fit.scope_boundary: OASIS+ is principally for non-IT professional services; IT/software may be ancillary to an in-scope professional-services requirement. Worldshepherd must be offered as an integrated professional/engineering/R&D solution, not as a standalone IT commodity vehicle.

qualification.mentor_protege_advantage: Protégé qualifying projects may use 50% of applicable minimum average annual value threshold under the published qualification rules.
required_next_evidence: verify average annual value and period-of-performance thresholds

route_A_direct.objective: Qualify for one or more Small Business OASIS+ domains once objective project evidence produces at least the required score.

route_B_team.objective: Team or subcontract under existing OASIS+ contract holders for R&D, engineering, logistics, intelligence, mission assurance, and enterprise work while accumulating qualifying project evidence.

route_C_enterprise.objective: Position Worldshepherd modules within existing Unrestricted Enterprise Solutions teams for $250M+ highly complex multi-disciplinary task orders; pursue direct Enterprise qualification only after scale, project, systems, and capital evidence justify it.
